d:
Does gold truly deserve a spot in your investment portfolio, or is it just an overhyped asset? To uncover the truth, we analyzed 30 years of real Indian market data from 1996 to 2026 and stress-tested four distinct portfolios across 242 rolling 10-year investment windows. Discover how a simple 10% gold allocation impacts your overall returns, reduces portfolio volatility, and acts as a psychological cushion during major market crashes. We also break down the hidden currency advantage that Indian investors get due to the depreciation of the Rupee against the Dollar.
